title: WGSL kernel text and dispatch
summary: Gives a printed WGSL kernel its meaning through a parser proved to invert the printer, defines the invocation and dispatch semantics of the device model, and proves a kernel by evaluating each statement of one invocation and folding the invocations' stores.
premises: The device model of 2026-10-04: IEEE32 binary32 results with the canonical NaN, race-free dispatch, the host's length word, a dispatch that covers the count, and no dynamic errors
Input buffers that hold Wasm arrays of 64-bit words and buffer sizes below 2^32
result: The dispatch leaves the output holding the Lean function's result as a Wasm array, distinct invocations store to distinct words, and the printed text parses to the kernel.
